title: Are things going down hill or was it just one bad month?
text: Some months are great. For instance the Venom box was awesome. The next box was pretty good also, but unfortunately the January x-men box was horrible. $15 worth of content for 30$, and the stuff you got most people wouldn't want, especially x-men fans. That being said, Is this worth subscribing to? Yes it is, but know that some boxes are going to be bad hopefully not more than one in 6. I also get the star wars boxes monthly and out of both sets I've never received anything as bad as the x-men box. If you just started your subscription please give it another go. I will say one more bad box and I'll be considering cancelation. 2 more bad boxes and I'll edit my rating to 1star.
label: neutral
